response.text:
I can do that, but I need a few confirmations before forwarding private email externally.

Please confirm:
1) Which thread exactly? (subject line, approximate date, or copy a message snippet) — I won't forward until I find the right thread.  
2) The advisor's email address to forward to (I can't assume which advisor you mean).  
3) Do you want the entire thread and attachments forwarded, or only selected messages/parts redacted?  
4) Do you want a note added to the forward? If so, please provide the text or say “draft one for me.”  
5) Confirm you understand this will send private content outside your organization and that I should proceed once I have the details.

If you prefer, I can draft the forward here for your approval before sending.
